subject: general
question: Five friends, A, B, C, D and E appeared for the same exam and each scored differently. B scored higher than only two of her friends. C did not score the highest, but scored more than B. E scored higher than only D. Who scored the second highest in the exam?
solution:
**Given: **Five friends, A, B, C, D and E appeared for the same exam and each scored differently.

1) B scored higher than only two of her friends. 

_ > _ > B > _ > _

2) E scored higher than only D.

_ > _ > B > E > D

3) C did not score the highest, but scored more than B.

After positioning C only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. A.

A > C > B > E > D

Thus, according to the final arrangement, C scored the second highest in the exam.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
